name: post_protocol_dev_ink_diagnostic
reason: The preregistered old-A widening radius cap failed to match the chosen main multi24 mean DEV ink area; the reported Lego residual was about 22.4%. Preserve that primary result and add an explicitly post-protocol control to test the ink-area confound.
purpose: Measure whether the primary fused-region result can be explained by increased projected ink, using the identical historical A graph and only a different fixed world-space tube radius. This does not repair or reselect the proposed fusion method.

inputs.development: Exactly the four frozen DEV cameras and their already generated RGB/alpha arrays per scene; no new renderer or extra geometry input.
inputs.target: Mean DEV binary ink pixels from real triangle rasterization of the already sealed main multi24 mesh.
inputs.control_topology: Unchanged historical FULL_GRAPH.npz xyz, original IDs and A edge pairs.
inputs.reserved: Only after this diagnostic asset seal, evaluate its fixed mesh on the eight frozen reserved cameras. They were already used by the main experiment and are not fresh blind data.

search.variable: One scene-wide fixed world-space tube radius; 8-sided closed tubes.
search.scene_D: Axis-aligned bounding-box diagonal of the already sealed main multi24 mesh.
search.expansion: Evaluate the starting radius, then double monotonically, clipping to scene_D/2, until mean DEV ink brackets the target or the upper bound is reached.
search.choose: Smallest absolute mean DEV ink error among all recorded trials; ties choose smaller world radius.
search.unmatched_policy: If the target is not bracketed or residual is at least 1%, keep the best actual control and report DIAGNOSTIC_UNMATCHED; do not alter the rule or main scientific verdict.
search.trial_record: Every world radius, four camera ink counts, mean ink, signed residual and relative absolute error; preserve negative and intermediate evidence.

visibility: The same calibrated CPU perspective triangle rasterizer, asset self-zbuffer only; x-ray relative to the original GS object, all rear regions retained.
outputs: Separate post_protocol_dev_ink_diagnostic directory, GLB/OBJ/NPZ and asset seal per scene; separate eight-view RGB/main/capped-control/exact-ink-control panels and metrics. No replacement of the main eight-view boards.
claim_limit: A post-protocol DEV-only area-matching diagnostic, not a preregistered fifth primary arm, algorithmic rescue, physical-edge certificate, or new blind test.
